description: Adds phrase translation button to option title and explain
find:
<xf:textboxrow name="title" value="{$option}"
				label="{{ phrase('title') }}" />

			<xf:textarearow name="explain" value="{$option}" autosize="true"
				label="{{ phrase('explanation') }}"
				hint="{{ phrase('you_may_use_html') }}" />
replace:
<xf:textboxrow name="title" value="{$option}"
				label="{{ phrase('title') }}"
				phrase="{{ $option.isUpdate() ? 'option.' . $option.option_id : '' }}" />

			<xf:textarearow name="explain" value="{$option}" autosize="true"
				label="{{ phrase('explanation') }}"
				hint="{{ phrase('you_may_use_html') }}"
				phrase="{{ $option.isUpdate() ? 'option_explain.' . $option.option_id : '' }}" />
